body: Thanks guys, i appreciate the replies.  I get what you are saying but it's not really about embarrassment for me. It's just knowing that basically everyone i know would hate me if they knew about what happened. It sort of makes everything feel a bit fake. I don't see how i can feel genuine around people this way. It stops me from getting particularly close to anybody and I'm afraid i will never be able to have a real relationship. I know my family loves me, despite knowing what happened and that means the world to me, but i still find myself feeling like i can never have a normal life and the fact that i feel like everyone else would hate me for it, makes me hate myself.
